decisions.reason: Ordering assistance does not change the existing component sourceability or JLCPCB extended-part selection policies.
Helping place the manufacturer order does not modify the required BOM contents or component specifications.
The ordering-assistance decision does not change the portability or footprint resolution of the KiCad project.
Manufacturer ordering assistance has no necessary effect on the rail-monitoring behavior or its selected circuitry.
The source decision concerns assistance with ordering and does not change interboard connector types, pinouts, or power topology.
Ordering assistance does not resolve or change the LED board's count, role, LED family, or outstanding part ambiguity.
The source message does not change the sensor-board connector inventory, pinouts, or module interfaces.
The ordering-assistance obligation does not change the LED supply voltage or data-level-shifter requirements.
The source decision has no effect on LED standby cutoff behavior, standby-current target, or control GPIO.
Assistance with the eventual manufacturer order does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, or VSYS power-path requirements.
The ordering-assistance decision does not change the BOOT or reset circuitry and associated capacitance values.
The source message does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or its board integration requirements.
